questions.questionText: What does the expression 'by all means' signify?
questions.expectedAnswer: The expression 'by all means' signifies giving permission or expressing strong agreement enthusiastically.

questions.questionText: Do you think playing video games can improve your cognitive skills?
questions.expectedAnswer: Yes, I think playing specific video games can improve cognitive skills, such as hand-eye coordination.

flashcards.definition: Relating to conscious mental activities such as thinking, understanding, or learning.
flashcards.example: "Vocal reflex drills speed up our cognitive processing when speaking English."
